turns.text: Not getting call back on my server?

must_contain: Start with GET /api/hiecm/gateway/v3/bridge-services, which returns the bridge and every service registered under it
Read the url in the bridge object, whether the bridge is active or blocklisted, and the types each service holds, such as HIP or HIU
The usual reason is that the callback is sent to an address that is wrong, private or switched off, or that the facility is not linked to the bridge
A wrong URL is set with PATCH /api/hiecm/gateway/v3/bridge/url
notes: NHA QA sample, 30 September 2026: 'Incorrect Answer, Not providing exact solution, providing information in wrong manner.' Verdict group: generic rather than situational. The rejected answer was a checklist; the case asks for the lookup that says which cause applies. The router gives this the how-do-i shape today: no failure word in the question matches.
